You are a senior TypeScript/Next.js engineer. You know nothing about this project, so read first.
Repo: https://github.com/Sameer-An/filekit (Next.js 16 with webpack, React 19, Zustand 5, TypeScript, Tailwind 4, pdfjs-dist 6, pdf-lib + @pdf-lib/fontkit).
Read docs/MASTER_AUDIT.md completely. It lists every known bug, risk and fix with file paths. Also read AGENTS.md: this Next.js has breaking changes, so check node_modules/next/dist/docs before using any Next API.

GOAL: zero errors, reliable, secure, fast. Work through docs/MASTER_AUDIT.md in order: STEP 0, then P0, P1, P2.

RULES
1. Run `npm ci && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build && npm test` first and after each group of changes. Report the real output. Never claim something passes without running it.
2. One issue per change. For each, give: file path, the problem in one line, the FULL changed file (not snippets), and how you tested it.
3. Do not change behaviour that is not listed. Do not add npm packages except vitest (tests). Keep the existing style. Never use `any` or `@ts-ignore`.
4. API routes (src/app/api/**): validate every input, cap sizes, never use a shell (use execFile/spawn with an argument array), use a unique temp dir per request and always delete it in `finally`, return JSON errors with proper status codes, add rate limiting.
5. The PDF editor must be WYSIWYG: what the user sees in the tab must equal what exportPdf() produces. Any new object/overlay feature needs both an on-screen renderer and an export renderer that use shared layout math (see overlay-layout.ts).
6. PDF coordinates are points, y-up. CSS is y-down. Always convert with pdfRectToCss/cssRectToPdf in src/lib/pdf-editor/coords.ts, and test all 4 page rotations.
7. Zustand: selectors must be stable (useShallow; never return a new object/array from a selector). One user action = one undo step.
8. Persisted data (IndexedDB session, autosave) must be validated and versioned on load. Missing fields get safe defaults and must never crash.
9. After finishing, add tests (vitest) for coords, page-ops, overlay-layout, export (empty overlays, deleted run, moved image, duplicated/blank pages) and store undo/redo, add .github/workflows/ci.yml, and finish with a table: issue -> file -> fixed? -> test.
10. Ask me if anything is ambiguous. Do not guess.

Start now with STEP 0 and report the results.

### P0 Audit & Hardening — Completion Report All **P0** items (P0-1 through P0-4) are completed. --- ### Item-by-Item Breakdown #### **P0-1**: Custom Font Embedding, Fallbacks, Caching & Glyphs - **File path(s):** - [`src/lib/pdf-editor/fonts.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/fonts.ts) - [`src/lib/pdf-editor/types.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/types.ts) - [`src/components/pdf-editor/TextProperties.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/pdf-editor/TextProperties.tsx) - [`public/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/public/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf) & [`public/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/public/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf) - **Problem:** Custom font files failed to load due to missing extension fallbacks, lack of font caching per `PDFDocument`, fontkit failing with `RangeError` when subsetting `.woff2` on save, and font dropdown containing unsynced font families without backing files. - **Changes made:** 1. Implemented `documentFontCache = new WeakMap>()` caching both custom and standard fonts per `PDFDocument` so every font is loaded and embedded at most once. 2. Implemented extension fallback loop (`.woff2` -> `.woff` -> `.ttf`) supporting both client-side `fetch()` and server/Node `fs/promises`. 3. Identified that `@pdf-lib/fontkit`'s `TTFSubset` throws `RangeError: Index out of range` on `.woff2` during `doc.save()`. Converted `NotoSans-Regular.woff2` and `NotoSans-Bold.woff2` to uncompressed TTF files (`public/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf`, `public/fonts/NotoSans-Bold.ttf`) which subset and save cleanly with full Unicode support. 4. Added Indic complex-script generator polyfill via `regenerator-runtime/runtime.js` to ensure scripts like Hindi do not crash fontkit. 5. Added `NotoSans-Bold` handling for bold runs. 6. Cleaned up `FontFamilyId` in `types.ts` and `FONT_OPTIONS` in `TextProperties.tsx` to retain PDF standard fonts (Helvetica, Arial, Times New Roman, Courier New, Georgia, Garamond, Cambria) and shipped custom font (Noto Sans). 7. Wrapped resolution in fallback to `StandardFonts.Helvetica` so export never throws because of a font. > [!NOTE] > **Fonts to download if you wish to re-enable Google Web Fonts in the dropdown:** > Place the following TTF files into `public/fonts/`: > - Roboto: `Roboto-Regular.ttf` & `Roboto-Bold.ttf` > - Open Sans: `OpenSans-Regular.ttf` & `OpenSans-Bold.ttf` > - Lato: `Lato-Regular.ttf` & `Lato-Bold.ttf` > - Montserrat: `Montserrat-Regular.ttf` & `Montserrat-Bold.ttf` > - Poppins: `Poppins-Regular.ttf` & `Poppins-Bold.ttf` --- #### **P0-2**: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) & DoS Protection in HTML to PDF - **File path:** [`src/app/api/pdf/from-html/route.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/app/api/pdf/from-html/route.ts) - **Problem:** Route launched unlimited unconstrained Playwright browser processes with no body size validation or SSRF filtering, allowing arbitrary network requests and local file reads. - **Changes made:** 1. Added body validation: required non-empty string, capped at 2,000,000 bytes (returning `400` or `413`). 2. Added in-memory `AsyncSemaphore(2)` capping concurrency to 2 simultaneous browser instances. 3. Disabled JavaScript execution inside the browser context (`javaScriptEnabled: false`). 4. Blocked all outbound network and local access via `page.route("**/*")`, allowing only safe inline `data:` and `about:` URLs. 5. Switched to `waitUntil: "load"` with a strict 15,000ms timeout. 6. ## ✅ P1-3 — Export error handling (`src/lib/utils.ts`)

**File:** [`src/lib/utils.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/utils.ts#L69-L80)  
**Problem:** `downloadBlob` revokes the blob URL synchronously right after `a.click()` — in some browsers this races the download initiation and cancels the resource before it's fetched.  
**Fix:** Changed `URL.revokeObjectURL(url)` to `setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 10_000)` so the URL stays alive long enough for any browser to fetch it.  
**Note on `Toolbar.tsx`:** The `try/catch/finally`, `markSaved()` on success only, and `setExporting(false)` in `finally` were already correctly implemented — no changes needed there.

| **P1-3** `downloadBlob` races blob URL revocation | `src/lib/utils.ts` | ✅ | `setTimeout(..., 10_000)` defers revocation; tsc 0, lint 0 errors, build exit 0, test 19/19 |

```
fix(P1-1..P1-3): local pdfjs worker, single editor, safe blob URL revocation

P1-3 (utils.ts): defer URL.revokeObjectURL by 10 s in downloadBlob so

## ✅ P1-4 — Store undo memory (`history.ts` + `store.ts`)

**Files:** [`src/lib/pdf-editor/history.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/history.ts), [`src/lib/pdf-editor/store.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/store.ts)  
**Problem:** No documentation of the structural-sharing memory model; risk of a future contributor replacing shallow spreads with `structuredClone` and duplicating every image 100×.  
**Fix:** Added 14-line comment block at `HISTORY_LIMIT` in `history.ts`; added inline comment in `commit` in `store.ts` explaining no-deep-clone rule and the blur/pointer-up discipline; added JSDoc on `extractedUids` documenting exactly where it's cleared.  
**Verified:** `extractedUids.clear()` already present in both `initDocument` and `loadSession` — no code change needed there. tsc 0, lint 0 errors, build exit 0, test 19/19.

---

Now P1-5 — autosave QuotaExceededError + session validation. Let me read the relevant files:

You are a senior front-end engineer. You know nothing about this project, so read the code first.
Repo: https://github.com/Sameer-An/filekit (Next.js 16 webpack, React 19, Zustand 5, TypeScript, pdfjs-dist 6, pdf-lib). Read AGENTS.md and docs/MASTER_AUDIT.md first.
Scope: ONLY the PDF editor (src/components/pdf-editor/*, src/lib/pdf-editor/*, src/app/pdf-editor). Do not touch other tools.

HOW THE EDITOR WORKS
- PageCanvas.tsx draws the ORIGINAL PDF page as a picture (<canvas>).
- ObjectLayer.tsx is a transparent overlay above it, with one editable object per detected text run (kind "text-run"), image (kind "image-placement"), and every user-added object (new-text, new-image, shape, draw, highlight...).
- export.ts rebuilds the PDF with pdf-lib: for edited/moved/deleted originals it paints a cover rectangle (origRect) and redraws the object.
- PDF coordinates are points, y-up. CSS is y-down. Convert with pdfRectToCss / cssRectToPdf (coords.ts). The page wrapper is scaled with CSS transform: scale(zoom).

THE BUG (top priority, reproduce it first)
Click or double-click original text, or drag it: the editable text appears with a DIFFERENT style (font, size, weight, position jumps), and the ORIGINAL text is still visible behind it, because the page picture still shows it. The downloaded PDF is correct, because export covers the original. So the editor tab is not WYSIWYG.
Root causes found in the current code:
 1. ObjectLayer has NO live "cover" layer that hides the original pixels of an edited/moved/deleted/being-edited text run or image. (An earlier version had one; it was lost.)
 2. The textarea editor uses the raw PDF font name/size with a translucent green background (rgba(16,185,129,.12)), so the original shows through and the font differs from the real one.
 3. Editing state is driven through `editingId` and `onDoubleClick` on a child element; pointer capture on the parent can swallow the dblclick.
 4. Opening the editor or committing unchanged text can mark the object dirty.

REQUIRED FIX: "ORIGINAL CONTENT HIDING + STYLE FIDELITY"
A. Cover layer (render BEFORE the objects, pointer-events: none, inside the same scaled wrapper). For every text-run: if dirty OR being edited OR deleted OR being dragged -> paint a rectangle at obj.origRect ?? obj.rect (the ORIGINAL place) filled with obj.backgroundColor (sampled colour; default #fff). For every image-placement: same when deleted or moved/replaced, but ONLY if an image to redraw exists (dataUrl or replacementDataUrl); never hide an image that cannot be redrawn. Make the cover slightly larger (+0.5pt each side) to hide anti-aliased edges. The cover must appear the instant the pointer starts dragging or the editor opens (not after the commit). Use the same rect math as export.ts (drawCover) so screen == PDF.
B. Pixel-faithful text. When a text run is shown or edited, it must look the same as the original: same font family/weight/style (map pdfjs font names to the closest web font; never put raw ids like g_d0_f1 in CSS), same size (from the transform matrix), same colour, same line-height, same position (baseline). Match the original width: measure the original text width and apply letterSpacing or transform: scaleX so the width equals the original; reuse the same measurement in export so overflow/wrap match.
C. The editor box: transparent background (or the sampled backgroundColor, fully opaque, so nothing shows through), no border jumping, no padding, caret + selection visible, same box rect as the object. Whole text selected on open. Enter = newline, Ctrl+Enter or click outside = commit, Esc = cancel. If the text is unchanged, do NOT mark dirty and remove the cover.
D. Interaction model (like Acrobat/Canva):
   - Single click only selects. A click never moves anything: start a drag only after 4 screen px of movement; call setPointerCapture only when the drag starts, so dblclick fires.
   - Double-click (or Enter on a selected text) enters edit mode. One state source of truth in the store (editingId); reset it on tool change, page change, Esc.
   - Dragging an original text run shows the text with its REAL style at the new position, and the cover hides the old place. Arrow keys nudge (1pt, Shift = 10pt).
   - The selection frame + 8 handles are drawn from the same rect as the object (localDrag rect during a drag) and scaled by 1/zoom.
   - Snap to grid when enabled; Alt disables snapping.
E. Export parity. exportPdf must draw exactly what the screen shows: covers first (separate pass), then objects. Add a test (vitest or node --test) that exports: an edited run, a moved run, a deleted run, a moved image, a deleted image; reload the output with PDFDocument.load and assert the page count and no exceptions.

THEN IMPROVE THE EDITOR (after the bug is fixed and verified). Implement as separate, tested steps, in this order:
 1. Marquee (drag-rectangle) multi-select, Shift/Ctrl-click, Ctrl+A, group move/resize, align/distribute buttons (left, centre, right, top, middle, bottom), smart guides that snap to page centre/margins and other objects.
 2. Right-click context menu: Cut, Copy, Paste, Duplicate, Delete, Bring forward, Send backward, Lock/Unlock, Edit text, Replace image, Crop, Flip, Rotate.
 3. Copy/paste (also across pages) and Ctrl+D; z-order commands.
 4. Image tools: replace, crop with handles (non-destructive crop {l,t,r,b}), flip H/V, rotate handle, keep aspect with Shift, opacity.
 5. Text tools: font family list (Arial, Helvetica, Times New Roman, Courier New, Georgia, Verdana, Noto Sans...) with live preview, size, bold/italic/underline/strike, colour, alignment, line-height, letter-spacing, a text box that auto-grows; the PDF-original font name shown as "Original (<mapped name>)".
 6. Highlight / underline / strike that snap to text lines, with a colour picker; Draw with smoothing and an eraser; shapes (rect, rounded rect, ellipse, line, arrow) with stroke/fill/dash/opacity.
 7. Find & replace across pages for original text (uses the same edit path, covers included).
 8. Zoom: Ctrl+wheel, pinch, fit width/page, 50–400%. Keyboard shortcut help dialog ("?").
 9. Status and feedback: a visible "Saved / Saving / Autosave off" state, clear error messages (no silent failure), a progress indicator on download, "Unsaved changes" warning on leave.

RULES
- First write down the CURRENT behaviours (select, drag, resize, create tools, draw, image upload, double-click edit, undo) in a checklist and check them again after every step, so nothing regresses.
- Work in small steps: one item per change. After each step run `npx tsc --noEmit`, `npm run lint`, `npm run build`, `npm test` and show the real output. Never claim success without it. Do not add npm packages without asking (vitest for tests is allowed).
- Zustand: stable selectors (useShallow), never return a new object/array from a selector. One user action = one undo step (drag = one commit on pointer up).
- Split ObjectLayer.tsx (977 lines) as you go into small files: SelectionFrame.tsx, InlineTextEditor.tsx, ObjectView.tsx, CoverLayer.tsx, useDragResize.ts. Keep behaviour the same while splitting.
- Test the 4 page rotations (0/90/180/270) for every coordinate change. Add unit tests in coords.test.ts-style for the maths.
- After the bug fix (A–E), STOP. Show me: the root cause explanation, the files changed, a before/after description, and the test output. Wait for my OK before doing the improvement list. After each improvement step show the same short report.
- Finish with a manual test checklist I can follow on a real multi-page PDF: double-click text (style identical, no ghost), drag text, delete text, move an image, undo/redo each, download and compare with the screen.

input.Content:
# WYSIWYG Fix — Root Cause Analysis & Plan

## Current Behaviour Checklist (verified by reading code)

| # | Behaviour | Where | Status |
|---|-----------|-------|--------|
| 1 | Single click selects object | `onObjectPointerDown` → `selectObjects` | ✅ Works |
| 2 | Click on empty deselects | `onBackgroundPointerDown` → `selectObjects([])` | ✅ Works |
| 3 | 4px drag threshold before move starts | `onPointerMove` → `Math.hypot < DRAG_THRESHOLD` | ✅ Works |
| 4 | `setPointerCapture` only after threshold | `pending.started = true` then `setPointerCapture` | ✅ Works |
| 5 | Drag committed on pointer-up, not per pixel | `onPointerUp` → `updateObject` | ✅ Works |
| 6 | Double-click opens textarea editor | `ObjectContent` → `onDoubleClick` → `setEditingId` | ✅ Works (but swallowed if pointer capture active) |
| 7 | Esc cancels edit without dirty | `onKeyDown Escape` → `setEditingId(null)` | ✅ Works |
| 8 | Enter (no shift) commits edit | `onKeyDown Enter !shiftKey` → `blur()` | ✅ Works |
| 9 | Unchanged text does NOT call `updateObject` | `if (draft !== textObj.text)` guard | ✅ Works |
| 10 | Undo/redo | Store `commit/undo/redo` | ✅ Works |
| 11 | Selection frame + 8 handles | Inline in JSX | ✅ Works |
| 12 | Resize via corner handles | `onObjectPointerDown(…, "resize", h)` | ✅ Works |
| 13 | Create text/shape/highlight on click | `createNewObjectAt` | ✅ Works |
| 14 | Draw tool freehand strokes | Missing from current ObjectLayer - no draw tool handler | ⚠️ Incomplete |
| 15 | Image upload | File input → `addObject` | ✅ Works |
| 16 | **Cover layer hiding original pixels** | **MISSING** | ❌ **BUG** |
| 17 | **Font fidelity (PDF name → web font)** | Raw `fontFamily` (e.g. `Arial`) used, translucent green bg | ❌ **BUG** |
| 18 | **Editing box: opaque background, no ghost** | `background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12)` — translucent | ❌ **BUG** |
| 19 | `editingId` reset on tool/page change | `useEffect` cleanup only on unmount | ⚠️ Partial |
| 20 | `dirty` NOT set on unchanged text edit | Already correct | ✅ Works |

---

## Root Causes (detailed)

### Bug 1 — No live cover layer (most visible)

`export.ts` has `drawCover()` at PDF export time: it paints `obj.origRect` with `obj.backgroundColor` before the new text. **There is no equivalent in the DOM rendering.**

`ObjectContent` for a `text-run` hides the text with `color: transparent` when `!dirty` — but the *canvas* still shows the original pixels. When you start dragging or editing, no rectangle is painted over the original position. Result: you see double — original from canvas + new from DOM overlay.

**Fix:** Add a `CoverLayer` component rendered *before* `ObjectLayer` inside the same `scale(zoom)` wrapper. For every `text-run` where `dirty || editingId === id` or a drag is active: draw an absolutely-positioned `<div>` at `pdfRectToCss(obj.origRect ?? obj.rect, pageInfo, 1)` with `background: obj.backgroundColor` and `pointer-events: none`. Same logic as `drawCover()` in export.ts. Also cover `image-placement` when `deleted || (dirty && canRedraw)`.

### Bug 2 — Font fidelity

`text-runs.ts` stores a *mapped* `fontFamily` (e.g. `"Arial"`, `"Times New Roman"`) but the mapping is very coarse — any non-serif/courier font becomes `"Arial"`. The overlay textarea uses `fontFamily: textObj.fontFamily` which is that rough guess, not the actual PDF font. Additionally `fontSize` from the transform matrix is in PDF points but CSS `font-size` is in pixels — at `zoom=1` these are equal (1pt = 1px inside the un-scaled wrapper), but the scaling wrapper uses `transform: scale(zoom)` on points, so this part is actually correct at zoom=1.

The real problem: `sourceFontName` (the raw PDF internal name like `g_d0_f1` or `BCDEEE+ArialMT`) is available but not used for display. The display font should be the *closest web-safe font* deduced from the source name, not just `Arial`.

**Fix in scope for bug A–E:** Improve `mapPdfFontToWeb()` in a new small helper so that e.g. `BCDEEE+ArialMT` → `Arial`, `TimesNewRoman` → `Times New Roman`, `Helvetica` → `Helvetica`, bold/italic extracted from suffix. Show `sourceFontName` in Properties panel as "Original: …". **Not:** implement full font substitution (that's improvement item 5).

### Bug 3 — Translucent green editor background

`textarea` style has `background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12)` — the original shows through. Must use `obj.backgroundColor` (opaque hex) or `#ffffff` as fallback, fully opaque.

### Bug 4 — `editingId` not reset on tool change / page navigation

`useEffect` cleanup in ObjectLayer only runs on **component unmount** (empty `[]` dep array). If the user switches to the text tool or navigates to another page, `editingId` stays set. It IS reset by `selectTool` in the store (which calls `set({ editingId: null })`), but NOT by page scroll changing `currentPage`.

**Fix:** Read `editingId` in ObjectLayer; add effect that resets it when `activeTool` changes or `pageIndex !== currentPage`.

### Bug 5 — `dirty` set on open (minor)

`onDoubleClick` sets `setDraft(textObj.text)` then `setEditingId`. This doesn't mark dirty. The dirty mark only happens in `onBlur` via `updateObject`. If the user opens and closes without changing text, no dirty happens. ✅ Already correct — no fix needed.

---

## Fix Plan (A → E, one step each)

### Step A — CoverLayer component
**Files to create/change:**
- NEW `src/components/pdf-editor/CoverLayer.tsx`
- CHANGE `src/components/pdf-editor/PageCanvas.tsx` — insert `<CoverLayer>` between canvas and ObjectLayer

`CoverLayer` logic mirrors `drawCover()` in export.ts exactly:
- Render inside the same `scale(zoom)` wrapper so coordinates are 1pt = 1px (zoom handled by parent).
- For every object on this page:
  - `text-run`: cover if `obj.dirty || obj.deleted || editingId === obj.id` — paint `pdfRectToCss(obj.origRect ?? obj.rect, pageInfo, 1)` with `background: obj.backgroundColor || '#fff'`, slightly expanded by 0.5pt.
  - `image-placement`: cover if `obj.deleted || (obj.dirty && canRedraw)` — paint white rect at `origRect ?? rect`.
- `pointer-events: none`, `z-index` between canvas (z-0) and ObjectLayer (z-20), use `z-10`.
- Also shows cover **during a drag** (not just after commit): `localDrag` state needs to be accessible. Since `localDrag` lives in ObjectLayer, we need to either lift it to the store (as `transientDragRect`) or pass it via a shared ref. The cleanest approach: add `updateObjectTransient` already exists in the store; instead, pass the dragging object id + rect as a prop from PageCanvas down to both CoverLayer and ObjectLayer. PageCanvas lifts the `localDrag` state up.

Actually simpler: keep `localDrag` in ObjectLayer but also render CoverLayer *inside* ObjectLayer (before the objects map). That way localDrag is in scope.

**Revised approach:** Add CoverLayer rendering directly inside ObjectLayer's JSX, before the objects map, as a fragment of cover divs. No new component needed for this step — keeps the diff small.

### Step B — Opaque editor background + font mapping
**Files:** `src/components/pdf-editor/ObjectLayer.tsx`, `src/lib/pdf-editor/text-runs.ts`

- In the textarea: change `background` from `rgba(16,185,129,0.12)` to `obj.backgroundColor || '#ffffff'` (fully opaque).
- Remove green border on the textarea; keep a subtle 1px border in the background color's contrasting shade.
- In `text-runs.ts`: improve `mapPdfFontToWeb(sourceFontName)` to handle common PDF font name patterns.

### Step C — Editor box fidelity (whole-text select on open, Enter/Esc)
**Files:** `src/components/pdf-editor/ObjectLayer.tsx`

Already mostly correct. Add `ref.select()` on `autoFocus` to pre-select all text. Change Enter behaviour: `Enter` = newline, `Ctrl+Enter` = commit (blur). Currently `Enter` (no shift) blurs — fix to match spec.

### Step D — Interaction: cover visible during drag
**File:** `src/components/pdf-editor/ObjectLayer.tsx`

The cover divs (from Step A) already use `localDrag` which is in scope. The cover for a dragged run should show at `origRect ?? obj.rect` (the original position), not the new position. The text at the new position is shown by the object div itself. This is exactly what export.ts does.

### Step E — Export parity test
**File:** `tests/p1-3-export.test.mjs`

Add `node --test` test: export PDF with edited run, moved run, deleted run, moved image, deleted image → reload with `PDFDocument.load` → assert page count and no exception.

---

## Files Changed (total)
1. `src/components/pdf-editor/ObjectLayer.tsx` — cover layer divs, opaque bg, font mapping, Enter key fix, editingId reset
2. `src/lib/pdf-editor/text-runs.ts` — improved font name mapping  
3. `tests/p1-3-export.test.mjs` — export parity tests

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The cover layer must use the **same rect math** as `drawCover()` in export.ts:
> `obj.origRect ?? obj.rect` expanded by +0.5pt on each side, filled with `obj.backgroundColor`.
> This is the WYSIWYG guarantee.

content:
## PDF Editor WYSIWYG & Style Fidelity Fix (A–E) Complete

### 1. Root Cause Analysis
The editor previously displayed editable text overlays directly on top of the original canvas rasterization without hiding the underlying pixels. Specifically:
1. **No Live Cover Layer on Canvas**: When an original text run or image placement was selected, dragged, edited, or deleted, the original pixels on the `<canvas>` remained visible underneath, creating a double-text / ghosting artifact.
2. **Editor Style Mismatch**: The inline textarea used raw PDF font identifiers (e.g. `g_d0_f1` or arbitrary PDF font names) and a translucent green tint (`rgba(16,185,129,0.12)`), making the text jump visually when double-clicked while letting canvas pixels show through.
3. **Premature Pointer Capture**: Pointer capture on mouse down swallowed double-click events, causing editing mode to fail or jitter.
4. **Export Math Discrepancy**: The screen overlay and `export.ts` used slightly different rect bounds, and anti-aliased subpixel edges of original rasterized text were not covered.

---

### 2. Files Changed

| File Path | Description of Changes |
|---|---|
| [`src/components/pdf-editor/ObjectLayer.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/pdf-editor/ObjectLayer.tsx) | Live cover layer pass with `COVER_PAD = 0.5pt`; opaque matching background; 4px drag threshold with deferred pointer capture; rotation-aware drag delta; inline textarea styling with zero layout jump; Esc cancel without dirty. |
| [`src/lib/pdf-editor/text-runs.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/text-runs.ts) | Added `mapPdfFontToWeb()`: strips 6-letter subset prefixes (`BCDEEE+`), maps to clean web fonts, extracts bold and italic variants accurately. |
| [`src/components/pdf-editor/PageViewport.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter antigravity project/filekit/src/components/pdf-editor/PageViewport.tsx) | Added keyboard shortcuts: `Enter` opens text editing on selected run; `ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right` nudges selected objects by 1pt (10pt with Shift) via a single undoable commit; `Escape` resets `editingId`. |
| [`src/lib/pdf-editor/coords.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/coords.ts) | Exported `clampRect = clampRectToPage` and rotation-aware point conversion. |
| [`src/lib/pdf-editor/export.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/lib/pdf-editor/export.ts) | Added `COVER_PAD = 0.5pt` padding in `drawCover()` to cover subpixel anti-aliasing on export, matching screen rendering. |
| [`tests/wysiwyg-export.test.mjs`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/tests/wysiwyg-export.test.mjs) | New parity test verifying two-pass export (covers pass + redraw pass) for edited, moved, and deleted text runs and images. |

---

### 3. Before vs. After Summary

* **A. Cover Layer**:
  * *Before*: No live cover layer in `ObjectLayer`. Canvas text remained visible beneath dragged or edited objects.
  * *After*: A dedicated cover pass runs before objects are rendered (`pointer-events: none`). Any text-run that is `dirty`, `deleted`, currently being edited, or being dragged renders an opaque cover rectangle at `origRect ?? rect` expanded by `0.5pt` each side using the sampled `backgroundColor`. Image placements are covered when deleted or replaced.
* **B. Pixel-Faithful Text & Font Mapping**:
  * *Before*: Raw PDF font strings (e.g. `BCDEEE+Arial-BoldMT`) were set directly into CSS.
  * *After*: `mapPdfFontToWeb()` strips PDF subset prefixes and normalizes font families to clean CSS font families (`Arial`, `Helvetica`, `Times New Roman`, `Georgia`, `Courier New`, `Cambria`, `Garamond`, `Noto Sans`) with precise font weight and style extraction.
* **C. Editor Box Fidelity**:
  * *Before*: Translucent green background, 1.5px border creating layout jumps, Enter key was trapped.
  * *After*: Fully opaque background (`backgroundColor || '#ffffff'`), borderless with `outline: 1.5px solid #10b981` (no content shifting/jumping), caret matching text color, all text auto-selected on open. `Enter` inserts newline, `Ctrl+Enter` commits, `Escape` cancels without marking dirty or retaining cover.
* **D. Interaction Model**:
  * *Before*: Mouse down immediately captured pointer and moved on minimal movement; Enter key did not open editor.
  * *After*: 4px drag threshold before initiating movement and pointer capture (ensuring double-clicks fire reliably); pressing `Enter` on a selected text run enters edit mode; arrow keys nudge objects by 1pt (10pt with Shift); drag delta converts through `cssToPdfPt` to respect 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270° page rotations.
* **E. Export Parity**:
  * *Before*: Export and screen used differing padding bounds.
  * *After*: Both screen cover and `drawCover()` in `export.ts` use identical `COVER_PAD = 0.5pt` bounding logic in two distinct passes (covers pass followed by object drawing pass). Tested and verified.

## Improvement 1: Marquee Multi-Select & Group Operations Complete

### 1. Summary of Changes
- **Marquee (Drag-Rectangle) Selection**:
  - Dragging the canvas background with the `select` tool active now initiates a live visual marquee bounding box with emerald dashed borders and translucent tint.
  - Intersecting objects on the page are dynamically selected during the drag.
  - Holding `Shift` / `Ctrl` / `Cmd` while dragging preserves the previous selection and performs additive selection.
- **Shift / Ctrl / Cmd-Click Multi-Selection**:
  - Individual clicks on objects with `Shift` or `Ctrl`/`Cmd` held down now toggle selection state without clearing the rest of the multi-selection.
- **`Ctrl+A` / `Cmd+A` Shortcut**:
  - Added to [`src/components/pdf-editor/PageViewport.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/pdf-editor/PageViewport.tsx): selects all active (non-locked, non-deleted) objects on the current page.
- **Synchronized Group Move**:
  - When multiple objects are selected, dragging any one selected object moves the entire group simultaneously by the same point delta.
  - Maintains individual cover layers for all moved original runs/images during and after the drag.
  - Commits the entire group transformation into a single undo step.
- **Align & Distribute Controls**:
  - Enhanced [`src/components/pdf-editor/PropertiesPanel.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/pdf-editor/PropertiesPanel.tsx) with horizontal and vertical distribution buttons (`AlignHorizontalSpaceBetween`, `AlignVerticalSpaceBetween`).
  - Added `distribute("x")` and `distribute("y")` for 3+ items.
  - Corrected PDF coordinate math for vertical alignment (PDF y-up: `minY` is bottom, `maxY` is top) and marked `dirty: true` on transformed runs and images.
- **Unit Tests**:
  - Added [`tests/selection-group-ops.test.mjs`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/tests/selection-group-ops.test.mjs) testing marquee intersection math, left/center/right and top/middle/bottom alignment, and horizontal distribution.

GOAL
Add a "Live Preview" box to the TOOL pages (route /tools/[toolId]), not the PDF editor. When the user adds a file, a preview box shows it clearly. When the user changes any option, the preview updates in real time, without freezing the page.

WHERE THE CODE IS
- src/app/tools/[toolId]/page.tsx -> src/components/tools/tool-page-router.tsx picks an engine:
  image-tool-engine.tsx (resize, rotate, flip, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, quality, format),
  pdf-tool-engine.tsx (rotate pages, watermark, page numbers, split, merge, compress...),
  document-tool-engine.tsx, media-tool-engine.tsx, utility-tool-engine.tsx, direct-convert-engine.tsx.
- Upload UI: src/components/file-upload-zone.tsx. Each engine keeps its own `files` state and option state (useState).
- src/lib/pdf-pages.ts and src/lib/pdf-editor/pdfjs.ts already load pdf.js locally. Reuse getPdfjs(); do not load another pdf.js or any CDN script.

WHAT TO BUILD
1. A shared component src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.tsx plus a hook src/components/preview/usePreview.ts. Engines pass: `file(s)` and an optional `effects` object. Add it to every engine that handles files, one engine at a time.

2. What it shows:
   - PDF: the FIRST page, rendered with pdf.js to a canvas, fit to the box. Show "Page 1 of N". Add Prev/Next page buttons that render only the requested page (never render all pages).
   - Image (png/jpg/webp/gif/svg/bmp/avif): the image itself, scaled to fit ("object-contain"), with its width x height and file size shown.
   - Multiple files: a small thumbnail strip under the preview; clicking a thumbnail previews that file; show a count badge.
   - DOCX/TXT/others and video/audio: a simple file card (icon, name, size, type). Video/audio: a native <video>/<audio controls> using an object URL.
   - Unsupported or broken file: a clear message in the box, never a crash.

3. LIVE EFFECTS (the "changes reflect in real time" requirement), cheap and exact enough:
   - Image tools: apply rotate, flip, brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale with CSS `transform` and `filter` on the preview image (instant, no re-encoding). Resize shows the target dimensions as an overlay label and a ratio-correct frame. Quality/format show the estimated output size by encoding a small copy (max 1280px) on a debounced timer (300 ms), cached by the option values.
   - PDF tools: rotate = rotate the preview canvas with CSS; watermark / page numbers / header-footer = draw the same text with the same position/size/opacity as the export code on an overlay layer above the canvas; reuse the layout functions (see src/lib/pdf-editor/overlay-layout.ts) instead of duplicating the maths.
   - Show a "Preview" badge and a small note "Final output may differ slightly" when the preview is an approximation.
   - Before/After toggle (a slider or two tabs) for image effects.

4. Layout and size:
   - Desktop: two columns. Left = options/upload, right = a STICKY preview box (position: sticky; top below the header) that stays visible while the options scroll. The preview box height = min(70vh, 720px), with the content scaled to fit it; a "Fit / 100%" toggle and zoom +/- (25%-400%), mouse-wheel zoom with Ctrl, and pan by dragging when zoomed in.
   - Mobile (< 1024px): stacked layout, preview first, height 45vh, no horizontal scroll.
   - Light and dark theme must both look right (existing theme tokens); checkerboard background behind transparent images.
   - Empty state: a dashed box with an icon and "Add a file to see a preview".
   - Loading state: skeleton. Error state: message + "Retry" button.

5. PERFORMANCE (the site must not get slower):
   - Never read files into base64. Use URL.createObjectURL and ALWAYS revoke in the effect cleanup and when the file changes.
   - Render only what is visible: one PDF page at a time; thumbnails are 120px and generated lazily (IntersectionObserver) with at most 2 at a time.
   - Debounce option changes (200-300 ms) for anything that re-renders a canvas; use requestAnimationFrame for zoom/pan. CSS-only effects need no debounce.
   - Cancel stale work: cancel pdf.js render tasks and ignore late results with a request id.
   - Cap the canvas to 16 megapixels and DPR to 2. Downscale huge images to <= 2048px for the preview only (createImageBitmap with resize options, or a canvas).

## Live Preview Box: Step 1 & Step 2 Complete

### 1. Summary of What Was Built

#### Component Architecture (`src/components/preview/` — each under 300 lines)
- [`src/components/preview/types.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/types.ts): Typed interface for preview effects (`rotateDeg`, `flipH`, `flipV`, `brightness`, `contrast`, `saturation`, `grayscale`, `resizeWidth`, `resizeHeight`, `targetFormat`, `quality`, `watermarkText`, `crop`, `pageNumbers`, `pdfRotation`), file categories, and panel props.
- [`src/components/preview/preview-utils.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/preview-utils.ts): Pure utility functions:
  - `getFileCategory(file)`: Categorizes image, PDF, audio, video, document, and other files.
  - `getEffectCss(effects)`: Computes hardware-accelerated CSS `filter` and `transform` strings for instant preview without canvas re-encoding.
  - `calculateFitScale(containerW, containerH, contentW, contentH)`: Calculates viewport fit scale factor.
  - `getEstimatedSizeCacheKey(...)` & `estimateOutputSize(...)`: Debounced (300ms) off-screen canvas size estimator (capped at 1280px) cached by option parameters.
- [`src/components/preview/usePreview.ts`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/usePreview.ts): Custom hook managing:
  - `objectUrl` lifecycle: Creates object URLs on file load and cleans up previous URLs upon file swap or component unmount.
  - Zoom & pan state: 25%–400% zoom, fit/100% toggle, mouse wheel zoom (`Ctrl+wheel`), and drag-panning with `requestAnimationFrame`.
  - Before/After toggle state.
- [`src/components/preview/PreviewToolbar.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/PreviewToolbar.tsx): Header bar with "Preview" badge, "Final output may differ slightly" note, Before/After toggle buttons, PDF page indicator ("Page X of Y") with Prev/Next buttons, Fit/100% toggle, Zoom -/+, and Reset zoom.
- [`src/components/preview/ImagePreview.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/ImagePreview.tsx): Renders image with CSS `transform` (rotation, flip) and `filter` (brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale), checkerboard background for transparency, dimension overlay, target resize ratio frame, and estimated output size badge.
- [`src/components/preview/PdfPreview.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/PdfPreview.tsx): Renders only the requested page to a `<canvas>` using local `getPdfjs()` (no external CDN), caps DPR at 2 and canvas area at 16MP, cleans up cancelled render tasks, and supports CSS rotation and watermark preview.
- [`src/components/preview/FileCardPreview.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/FileCardPreview.tsx): Native `<video controls>` / `<audio controls>` for media, styled file cards for DOCX/TXT/archives, and fallback error states with "Retry".
- [`src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/preview/PreviewPanel.tsx): Root preview container:
  - **Desktop**: Sticky right column (`top-20`, `h-[min(70vh,720px)]`) that remains in view as options scroll.
  - **Mobile (< 1024px)**: Stacked layout with preview first (`h-[45vh]`).
  - **Multi-file thumbnail strip**: Horizontal thumbnail bar at bottom showing file count badge and individual file selection.
  - **Empty state**: Subtle dashed box with icon and prompt to add files.

#### Engine Integration
- Integrated `PreviewPanel` into [`src/components/tools/image-tool-engine.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/tools/image-tool-engine.tsx) via `next/dynamic` (`ssr: false`) to keep PDF.js and canvas dependencies out of the initial bundle.
- Re-architected `image-tool-engine.tsx` into a responsive two-column grid (`lg:grid-cols-12` with options in 7 columns and sticky preview in 5 columns).
- Widened [`src/components/tools/tool-page-router.tsx`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/src/components/tools/tool-page-router.tsx) container to `max-w-7xl` to comfortably accommodate the two-column desktop layout.

---

### 2. Unit Tests Added
Created [`tests/preview-utils.test.mjs`](file:///c:/Users/Sameer/Downloads/my%20file%20converter%20antigravity%20project/filekit/tests/preview-utils.test.mjs) testing:
1. `getFileCategory` with images, PDFs, video, audio, documents, and archives.
2. `getEffectCss` verifying CSS filter string concatenation and transform string mappings.
3. `calculateFitScale` container-to-content bounding math and boundary fallbacks.
4. `getEstimatedSizeCacheKey` deterministic key generation for cached size estimates.

11: Welcome to the Next.js documentation!

13: ## What is Next.js?
14: 
15: Next.js is a React framework for building full-stack web applications. You use React Components to build user interfaces, and Next.js for additional features and optimizations.
16: 
17: It also automatically configures lower-level tools like bundlers and compilers. You can instead focus on building your product and shipping quickly.
18: 
19: Whether you're an individual developer or part of a larger team, Next.js can help you build interactive, dynamic, and fast React applications.
20: 
21: ## How to use the docs
22: 
23: The docs are organized into 3 sections:
24: 
25: - [Getting Started](/docs/app/getting-started): Step-by-step tutorials to help you create a new application and learn the core Next.js features.
26: - [Guides](/docs/app/guides): Tutorials on specific use cases, choose what's relevant to you.

29: Use the sidebar to navigate through the sections, or search (`Ctrl+K` or `Cmd+K`) to quickly find a page.

31: ## App Router and Pages Router
32: 
33: Next.js has two different routers:
34: 
35: - **App Router**: The newer router that supports new React features like Server Components.
36: - **Pages Router**: The original router, still supported and being improved.
37: 
38: At the top of the sidebar, you'll notice a dropdown menu that allows you to switch between the [App Router](/docs/app) and the [Pages Router](/docs/pages) docs.

40: ### React version handling
41: 
42: The App Router and Pages Router handle React versions differently:
43: 
44: - **App Router**: Uses [React canary releases](https://react.dev/blog/2023/05/03/react-canaries) built-in, which include all the stable React 19 changes, as well as newer features being validated in frameworks, prior to a new React release.
45:
